title: Demo
wikitext:
A demo is a QuakeWorld match recorded and saved locally as a file ([[MVD|mvd]]/[[qwd]]/[[qwz]]). You play a demo by using the command /playdemo .
To record a demo type /demo At the most of today's [[servers]] demos are auto-recorded and can be downloaded from the server by typing /cmd dl where number represents the number the demo has in the demolist which is display by using the command /cmd dlist. Some good websites for demos: * [http://challenge-tv.com Challenge-TV.com] * [http://esreality.com ESReality.com] * [http://cyberfight.ru Cyberfight.ru] {{terminology}}
